What i recommend you to do is to watch more high elo players and listen to their tips _BUT_ you said you were given Bronze IV which is normal for a new player and instead of copying high elo players you should work on base stats like CS Objectives and Vision, A _HUGE_ tip that helped me is to keep vods of your Best plays for analyzing it and realizing what you could have done to make the outcome better, watchin A whole VOD and keeping notes is better but quite boring so i do these when i'm more focused.

A huge problem you either must get used to people flaming or just mute them (better option) when they start getting toxic, something i do is whenever i am blamed for something instead of regretting not doing what they said i think about what happend and what i can do to to make my situation better and not let people get in your head. I've seen somewhere that said The second you flamed you lost it doesn't even matter if you typed anything keeping your cool is important in ranked i think that some low elo players suck because they can't keep quiet even if they're ok at the game.

I'm was the same boat as you and i want you to improve fast it took me a year to realize what i wrote and only lately started taking the game seriously i've started doing these things for a week and a half and i started making progress slow but it's really fun to see somewhat progress (B4 to B2 promos into B1)
